surface: The initial Octane-native surface contains Button, RefreshButton, LinkButton, Loader, Tooltip, TooltipProvider, LinkProvider, and KumoPortalProvider. Presence records availability only; the remaining Kumo catalog and primitive subpaths are not yet exported.
divergences: Handlers receive native DOM events rather than React synthetic events.
Refs use Octane ref-as-prop rather than React forwardRef.
Icon components and descriptors use @octanejs/phosphor-icons and Octane types.
The emergency octane-kumo/react compatibility subpath is not present because this slice has no irreducibly React-backed surface.
ssr: The Button vertical is covered for real server compilation, hydration node adoption, and post-hydration interaction. Broader component SSR and hydration remain unverified.
notes: Button-family DOM behavior, native events, refs, loading transitions, icon forms, and tooltip trigger composition have repo-authored Octane tests.
The package contract resolves root and component subpath imports and rejects React or ReactCompat imports in native source.
The upstream Kumo styles are shipped through stable export paths and guarded by exact SHA-256 source-copy checks.
Representative Button variants, disabled/loading states, and light/dark modes have a reproducible visual fixture.
Tooltip popup interactions and visual parity are not covered by the current unit lane.
No React differential lane has been recorded yet.
